column1: # Swedish names for the chains of the period explorer (period models with 8 topics), used by
# modeling/17_generate_period_explorer.py. A chain follows matched topics through the four
# periods; its name summarizes the four period topics (config/period_topic_names_8.tsv).
# Format: chain number, the chain's topic numbers in the four periods, name (tab-separated).
# The generator shows a name only if the chain still consists of these topics, so a refitted
# model or a changed matching gets no wrong names.
